title: Closed embedding of rank-two Donaldson–Uhlenbeck–Yau moduli from the projective plane into a very general genus-two K3 double cover
author: Laure Flapan; Emanuele Macrì; Kieran G. O’Grady; Giulia Saccà
work: The geometry of antisymplectic involutions, II
source_version: Journal de l’École polytechnique — Mathématiques 13 (2026), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/jep.337
difficulty_reason: Properness and injectivity of pullback do not by themselves give a closed embedding at the singular Donaldson–Uhlenbeck–Yau strata. The authors construct a new explicit ramified matrix lift, prove invariant-ring surjectivity from the complete lifted trace/scalar-product generators, and control the resulting fixed analytic germs and normality. Their full local moduli/formality/quiver analysis then supports the normality-and-Zariski-Main closing step, rather than leaving the singular-stratum obligation as background.
